en.title: Fire-and-Forget in a Request Handler: Why Work Gets Lost and What to Use Instead
en.subtitle: A discarded Task.Run belongs to nobody: it borrows services from a finished request, its errors go unseen, and shutdown doesn't wait for it. Hand the work to a hosted service through a bounded queue.

ar-EG.title: ليه الشغل اللي بتعمله fire-and-forget جوه الـ request بيضيع؟ وتستخدم إيه بداله
ar-EG.subtitle: الـ Task.Run اللي بترميه ملهوش صاحب: بيستلف services من request خلص، والأخطاء بتاعته محدش بيشوفها، والـ shutdown مش بيستناه. سلّم الشغل لـ hosted service من خلال queue محدود.
